provenance_keys.cc-capture: observed in a request Claude Code sent to the fake API
provenance_keys.binary string: string in the Claude Code 2.1.327 binary
provenance_keys.session: observed in a live Claude Code 2.1.327 session on this machine
provenance_keys.inferred: fitted to captured data points; approximate

tool_set.note: Claude Code also sends Agent, ListAgents, ReportFindings, ScheduleWakeup, Skill, ToolSearch, Workflow and a deferred placeholder; no Grep or Glob on macOS

base_context_management.harness: sent in every arm; arms c and d append clear_tool_uses_20250919

anthropic_version.harness: 2026-10-21 per design, identical in every arm

cache_breakpoints.value: system blocks 1 and 2 (5-minute ephemeral) plus the last content block of the last message

shell.value: /bin/zsh -c: source the snapshot (grep as ugrep, find as bfs), setopt NO_EXTENDED_GLOB NO_BARE_GLOB_QUAL NO_BRACE_CCL NO_MAGIC_EQUAL_SUBST NO_EQUALS, unalias which and unsetenv, eval the command, then pwd -P only if it succeeded
shell.provenance: cc-capture + process listing of a live Claude Code 2.1.327 session

bash_merge_streams.value: stdout and stderr interleaved in one stream

bash_persisted_format.value:
<persisted-output>
Output too large ({size}). Full output saved to: {path}

Preview (first 2KB):
{preview}
...
</persisted-output>

bash_persisted_size.value: len/1024 with one decimal, then KB

bash_preview.value: first 2000 characters cut back to the last newline, without it

bash_failure_excerpt.value:
if len('Exit code N
' + output) > 10000: head 5000 + '

... [{n} characters truncated] ...

' + tail 5000

bash_timeout.value: Exit code 143\nCommand timed out after {s}s, is_error

bash_cwd.value: cd persists when the command succeeds and ends inside the project; outside, output gets '\nShell cwd was reset to {root}'; a failed command keeps the previous cwd

bash_background.value: supported by Claude Code -p; harness rejects with 'Background tasks are disabled in this session.'

read_render.value: '{n}\t{line}' for every line of content.split('\n'), including the empty last line

read_max_bytes_error.value: File content ({size}KB) exceeds maximum allowed size (256KB). Use offset and limit parameters to read specific portions of the file, or search for specific content instead of reading the whole file. To read it anyway, up to what still fits in your context, call Read again with allow_large: true — only if you genuinely need all of it or the user asked for the whole file.

read_token_counter.value: POST /v1/messages/count_tokens with {model, messages:[{role:user, content:<raw file text>}], tools:[]}

read_partial_cut.value: keep whole lines while raw bytes <= raw_bytes * cap / tokens * 0.85
read_partial_cut.provenance: inferred (exact on uniform lines; 4% long on an uneven file)

read_partial_notice.value: role:system message '[Truncated: PARTIAL view — {path}: showing lines 1-{k} of {total} total ({tokens} tokens, cap 25000). ...'

read_empty.value: <system-reminder>Warning: the file exists but the contents are empty.</system-reminder>

read_past_end.value: <system-reminder>Warning: the file exists but is shorter than the provided offset ({offset}). The file has {n} lines.</system-reminder>

read_missing.value: File does not exist. Note: your current working directory is {cwd}.

read_dir.value: EISDIR: illegal operation on a directory, read '{path}'

edit_success.value: The file {path} has been updated successfully.
edit_success.suffix_when_read: (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)

edit_errors.value: <tool_use_error>...</tool_use_error> for not found, multiple matches, identical strings, missing file

write_partial_refused.value: <tool_use_error>File has not been read yet. Read it first before writing to it.</tool_use_error> after only a PARTIAL view; offset/limit reads and unread files are allowed

input_validation.value:
<tool_use_error>InputValidationError: {Tool} failed due to the following issues:
...</tool_use_error>

file_changed_note.value: role:system 'Note: {path} changed on disk since you last read it. ...'

progress_nudge.value: role:system 'The user hasn't heard from you in a while. ...' after tool results 5, 10 and 15 without assistant text

hook_additional_context.value: role:system '{Event}:{Tool} hook additional context: {text}' after the tool results, joined with other notes by a blank line

hook_updated_tool_output.value: replaces the structured output before rendering; schema mismatch falls back to the original

session_start_context.value: appended to the environment system message before the date line in the first request
session_start_context.provenance: cc-capture (hook finished before the first request)

claude_md.value: <system-reminder> 'Codebase and user instructions are shown below...' with 'Contents of {path} (project instructions, checked into the codebase):' sections, imports after the importing file
claude_md.open: claude -p under an isolated HOME did not include the project CLAUDE.md in three offline probes

open_items: CLAUDE.md is not loaded by claude -p 2.1.327 under an isolated HOME in offline probes (three variants: default, CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT=cli, a trusted ~/.claude.json), nor in the dry anchor; the harness includes it as interactive Claude Code does, and the anchor records claude_md_seen from the proxy log.
Claude Code dropped earlier fake thinking blocks from history in the offline capture; real signatures may behave differently.
The PARTIAL-view page size rule is fitted to two files.
The progress nudge trigger is inferred from one scripted session.
